2930-4222-8328.easyPrerequisites:
You control an Island.
Freed from the Real attached to Portent Tracker.
Portent Tracker does not have summoning sickness.
2930-4222-8328.notablePrerequisites: Rikala has exactly three tide counters on it.
2930-4222-8328.description:
Activate an Island by tapping it, adding {U}.
Rikala triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Portent Tracker by tapping it, untapping the Island.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Portent Tracker.
Repeat from step 1

2527-3025-4076-4279-4549.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc that has toughness 2 or more.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
2527-3025-4076-4279-4549.description:
Activate Relic of Legends' second ability by tapping Burakos, adding one mana of any color.
Burakos triggers, causing it and other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and undying until end of turn.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the other Cleric, Rogue, Warrior, Wizard or Orc, targeting Burakos
When the creature dies, the creature's undying ability and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Burakos and causing you to draw a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing Burakos, targeting the other creature.
When Burakos dies, its undying ability and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning Burakos from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the other creature and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1680-4881-6909-8198.manaNeeded: {4}{B}{G} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
1680-4881-6909-8198.easyPrerequisites: Runed Stalactite is attached to Carnage.
1680-4881-6909-8198.description:
Cast Trystan's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

1479-2443-2841-3703.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Evolving Wilds.
1479-2443-2841-3703.description:
Fetch a land using Evolving Wilds.
When the fetched land enters, Sporemound and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Sporemound trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sporemound from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Sporemound triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

1981-2415-3967-7192.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Grave Venerations and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, giving them indestructible until end of turn.
Repeat.

728-5170-6132-6794.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Susurian Voidborn trigger.
Resolve the Susurian Voidborn trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

2738-4871-6112-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Fumulus, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Fumulus trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1349-2292-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature with a coin counter on it.
1349-2292-6854.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Host of the Hereafter's ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a coin counter onto itself as well as +1/+1 counters if those were present.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Host of the Hereafter.
When Host of the Hereafter dies, it and Athreos's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a coin counter and +1/+1 counters onto the other nontoken creature.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Host of the Hereafter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 6.
Repeat.

225-851-2557-4094-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
225-851-2557-4094-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Stone-Seeder Hierophant triggers eight times
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a New Planet.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining triggers.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

2557-3129-4826-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1017-3532-5078-7753.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Falco Spara.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2523-2869-4661.description:
Cast Vesuvan Doppelganger by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Vesuvan Doppelganger into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Vesuvan Doppelganger dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Vesuvan Doppelganger that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Vesuvan Doppelganger token instead.
2523-2869-4661.notes: This combo produces a mandatory infinite loop that'll cause the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3112-6798-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Slurrk.
When Slurrk dies, its innate ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve Slurrk's innate ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control that already has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve Slurrk's persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with four +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

3059-3231-7408.description:
Cast Malignus by paying {3}{R}{R}. It'll enter with power equal to half the highest life total among your opponents, rounded up.
When Malignus enters, Champion of the Path triggers, causing Malignus to deal damage equal to its power doubled to each opponent due to Dictate of the Twin Gods.
3059-3231-7408.notes: Malignus also makes the damage unpreventable due to its static effect. This combo should result in each opponent losing the game except in niche circumstances.

914-3036-7175.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3036-7175.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Wizard Mentor by paying {2}{U}.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

uses.n: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion

1399-1606-7069-7176.description:
Activate Oko's first loyalty ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Ley Weaver to gain all creature types.
Activate Tectonic Split by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Tectonic Split.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2

360-2919-3490-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
360-2919-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

874-1170-1329-3499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-1170-1329-3499.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Delif's Cone from your graveyard.
Cast Delif's Cone by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

288-2757-3000-6705.description:
Activate Oketra by paying {3}{W}, creating a 1/1 Frog, a 1/1 Warrior and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Warrior, Squirrel or Frog, untapping a basic Plains.
Activate the Plains by tapping it, adding {W}.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

2060-3169-4013-4929-6457.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Felothar.
When Felothar enters the battlefield, it and Genesis Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Genesis Chamber trigger, creating a token.
Resolve the Felothar trigger, causing you to sacrifice a nonland permanent and put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
2060-3169-4013-4929-6457.notes: The combo does not put infinite +1/+1 counters on Felothar, Crystalline Crawler or Cryptic Trilobite.

1940-5147-6249--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1940-5147-6249--5.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger.
Resolve the Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

654-1479-4488-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
654-1479-4488-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Rampaging Baloths and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Rampaging Baloths triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

1545-3000-5670.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1545-3000-5670.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Trostani, Selesnya's Voice triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

864-1312-2034-4871-4927.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Witness, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Witness dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Doomed Necromancer by paying {B}, tapping it and sacrificing it.
When Doomed Necromancer dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Doomed Necromancer ability, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Doomed Necromancer from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Doomed Necromancer by paying {2}{B}.
Repeat.

1109-1636-2438-5319.notablePrerequisites:
Skeleton Ship does not have summoning sickness.
Geralf's Messenger does not have any +1/+1 counters.
1109-1636-2438-5319.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger.
Geralf's Messenger dies, triggering its undying ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Geralf's Messenger enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Intruder Alarm.
Resolve the Geralf's Messenger trigger, causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Skeleton Ship by tapping it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Geralf's Messenger.
Repeat.

2249-3197-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2249-3197-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing any other creature.
Death's Presece triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Herd Baloth equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

273-1475-4050.notablePrerequisites:
One with the Kami attached to any creature you control.
Shuko attached to any creature you control except the creature with One with the Kami attached.
273-1475-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with Shuko attached, adding one mana of any color.
One with the Kami triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Spirit creature tokens equal to that creature's power.
Activate Shuko's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to a Spirit token.
Repeat.

2060-4499-4751.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Verdurous Gearhulk.
Verdurous Gearhulk enters the battlefield, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1987-2556-3075-4714.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters.
1987-2556-3075-4714.description:
Activate Mana Geode by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Mana Geode and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Mana Geode enters the battlefield, scry 1.
Repeat.

3011-3333-4086.description: Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, causing it to deal lethal damage to each opponent with an even life total, nearly lethal damage to each opponent with an odd life total, and damage to you that does not cause your life total to change due to Platinum Emperion.
